start.text: Captain Renna watches the road with a hand resting near her sword. Rain beads on the iron rim of her cloak-pin.

choices.text: I can close the first report on the missing caravan.
I found fresh wagon ruts by the old shrine.
Someone pressed a toll disc into a dead mule's eye.
You keep looking at my hands. Is it the magic?
I have walked caravan roads. Tell me where yours broke pattern.
You look like you expected the caravan to vanish.
I am looking for work.
What happened here?
Nothing for now.

arcane_suspicion.text: Renna does not deny it. "It is the villages magic leaves behind. Burned barns, missing children, saints with iron in their mouths. If you can help without making Wolfpine fear you more than the road, then help. If you cannot, keep your hands quiet."

choices.text: I am here to solve the road, not frighten your village.
Then point me at the problem and keep your iron charm.

arcane_suspicion_softened.text: "Good answer. Better if it stays true after dark. The old shrine is where fear has started gathering. Begin there if you want to be useful."

choices.text: I will start at the shrine.

caravan_guard_read.text: Renna studies the mud on your boots and the way your eyes keep measuring the road. "Then you know wagons do not vanish. They slow, split, stop, or get invited somewhere worse. Our rear driver was cautious. Too cautious to leave the road without a familiar signal."

choices.text: Then I should look for a sign meant for drivers, not tracks meant for hunters.
I will start where the road first lies.

caravan_guard_followup.text: "Good. Look for cloth knots, chalk on stone, cut bark. Caravan folk warn each other quietly. Someone may have used that language against them."

choices.text: I know the marks.

renna_pressure_read.text: Renna's eyes flick to the south gate before she answers. "I expected trouble. That is different. A hungry village grows teeth, and not all of them point outward."

choices.text: Then someone inside Wolfpine may have helped.
I will start with the road.

inside_help.text: "Maybe. Ask quietly. If you accuse loudly and you are wrong, the guilty will run. If you are right, they may do worse."

choices.text: Understood.

work_offer.text: Then you came to the right starving village. A caravan vanished two nights ago. Find it, and Wolfpine will remember your name kindly.

choices.text: I will look into it.

missing_caravan.text: Food, lamp oil, arrow shafts, medicine. Enough to keep Wolfpine breathing another month. Now it is gone, and everyone has a theory.

choices.text: Who benefits if the caravan disappears?
I see.

suspects.text: Bandits benefit. Smugglers benefit. A lord benefits if a village begs. Ask better questions than I can afford to ask aloud.

choices.text: Then I will ask them quietly.

shrine_found_report.text: Renna's expression tightens. Fresh ruts by that shrine means the caravan left the road before it vanished. That was not panic. Someone guided it there.

choices.text: Who knew the caravan route?
I will keep digging.

route_knowledge.text: Too many. The drivers, my guard detail, the miller who counted the grain, and anyone drinking near the south gate. Start with those who look frightened, not guilty.

choices.text: Understood.

close_first_report.text: Renna listens without interrupting, then marks the shrine and the wagon ruts on a damp strip of map. "This is enough to move patrols and stop the village inventing ghosts. It does not end the danger, but it gives us our first honest answer."

choices.text: Then mark the caravan matter resolved for now.
Not yet. I will keep looking.

resolved_first_report.text: "Done. Wolfpine owes you coin, and more importantly, fewer lies. If you keep digging, bring me proof I can hang from a gate."

end.text: Renna looks back to the road.

toll_disc_report.text: Renna goes still in a way shouting never manages. "That is not bandit work. Bandits steal tolls; they do not pay them to dead animals." She wipes rain from her mouth and lowers her voice. "Do not repeat that in the village unless you want every old woman counting graves by supper."

choices.text: You know what it means.
Then I will keep it quiet for now.

renna_toll_disc_meaning.text: "I know what road stories say it means. A passage paid after death. A debt collected by the old stones. I also know stories make poor evidence and excellent riots. Bring me the hand that pressed it there."

choices.text: Who would know the old road stories?
I will bring proof, not panic.

old_road_stories.text: "Rangers. Shrine-keepers. Old drivers. Anyone who has lost enough people to start listening to mile-stones. Ask carefully. People confess strange things when they think the road itself is listening."

choices.text: Understood.
